items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of disability pension
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wed), the day of posting (Aufgabe zur Post). The letter states the decision 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'. Counting the day after posting as day 1 (Nov 19 Thu = day1, Nov 20 Fri = day2, Nov 21 Sat = day3, Nov 22 Sun = day4), the 4th day falls on Sunday 22.11.2026. Under established case law applying §193 BGB analogously to the Bekanntgabefiktion, if that day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, deemed delivery moves to the next working day: Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§26 SGB X with §187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB) starts the day after the event (Bekanntgabe) occurring on 23.11.2026, i.e. begins 24.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number as the start-of-fiction day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so it remains the deadline.

warnings: The deemed-delivery date depends on the actual day the letter was handed to the postal service; this was assumed to be the document date (18.11.2026) because no separate posting date is given.
